paper_metadata.title: Investigations on the thermo-mechanical fatigue of two Ni-based single-crystal superalloys

evidence.quote: The out-of-phase thermo-mechanical fatigue (OP TMF) of two Ni-based single-crystal (SC) superalloys, TMS-75 and TMS-82+, has been investigated.
